projects.name: Clean Streets Kolkata
projects.description: Volunteer clean-ups of littered street corners and drains across Kolkata. Each spot is photographed before and after the drive.

projects.name: Mangrove Restoration, Gosaba
projects.description: Planting mangrove saplings along embankments in the Sundarbans to slow erosion and protect villages from storm surges.

projects.name: Pond Revival, South Kolkata
projects.description: Removing waste and silt from neighbourhood ponds and planting the banks, with residents' committees maintaining them afterwards.
